# ZOMBIES spec-coverage warnings
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #134, sha256:c337b0a6b7d17684f1ae5439dd2cbf94cbe92586a0a63be0d1fad789a6aa4779). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->




- **Status:** Ready

- **Shape:** Story

- **Type:** feature (thin slice; compiler warnings, never errors)

- **Milestone:** Usable v1 (shortest path to a real prototype)

- **Source:** Product direction, 2026-10-27 (reach a real prototype first) and Decider D86 (Codex No with fixes that were adopted, Grok Support-it): the shortest path to a real multi-endpoint app written in Phrase that compiles, builds, passes its generated specs and runs. Replaces the dependency chain of cards 008 to 012 and 057, which pulled in the base-library line and a deferred rule card.

- **Depends on:** 138

- **Story:** As Ari, I want the compiler to tell me which ZOMBIES categories (Zero, One, Many, Boundaries, Interface, Exceptions, Simple scenarios) each phrase's specs cover and to warn about obvious gaps, so that I can trust my specs as much as my code.

- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**

  1. Given orders.phrase, When it is compiled, Then the output reports that the positive-quantity phrase has failure specs but no success spec, so the One/Boundary success case (a valid quantity such as 1) is missing (a warning naming the phrase and the missing case), and compilation still succeeds

  2. Given a phrase with a numeric or comparison guard, When it is compiled, Then a warning names the missing spec at the boundary value on each of the three positions (below, at, above) that has none; a phrase with a list input and no Zero, One and Many cases warns for each missing one; a declared fails with code that no spec exercises warns

  3. Given a phrase whose specs cover everything relevant, When it is compiled, Then no warning is printed, categories that do not apply to a phrase are not reported, and the findings are warnings on a path that does not fail compilation (an existing error stays an error)



## Context



- The product owner's idea after the card 106 survivor (a One/Boundary gap). Warnings only, by the product owner's choice; boundary rules are syntax-aware. Hypothesis to measure afterwards, not part of this card: mutation-kill on real files rises as the gaps are filled and model-written Phrase passes more hidden cases. Card 055 (a hard error for a missing failure-path spec) is superseded by this card because a hard error conflicts with warnings-only.
